description: Scenario: operator deploys stoa-reader with any backend config; server restarts after articles are posted. store/server_stores.rs always constructs log_storage as MemLogStorage (Arc<MemLogStorage::new()>). MemLogStorage is in-memory only. Consequence: all CRDT group log entries accumulated since last start are lost. Peers that sync from this node will miss all articles posted in the prior run. The in-memory choice is nowhere documented as a known limitation or placeholder.
title: MemLogStorage used in production — group log lost on restart
